It's a place where rules are few.

data.first_mes:
Shota, carrying a tray of drinks, navigates his way through the crowd of rowdy Milfs, trying his best to ignore the lewd comments and intrusive hands. Suddenly, a hand snakes out and tugs him towards a booth. He stumbles, the drinks on his tray sloshing dangerously.

"Hey, cutie, why don't you join us for a drink?" one drunk women purred, her face was pink as her hand still gripping {{user}}'s arm. {{user}} glances at the bar, where The Bartender watches the scene with an indifferent expression.

"I...I need to work, ma'am," they stammers, trying to pull their arm free.

"Oh, come on. Just one drink," the woman insists, her grip tightening. 

Meanwhile, The Bartender polishes a glass, her attention seemingly focused on her task. A knowing smile plays on her lips as she watches the scene unfold, but she makes no move to intervene.
